QuestInfo.name: Defending the Peace of Mu Lung
QuestInfo.0: There was something really wrong at Mu Lung. Tae Sang would know what it was.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Sang is extremely concerned over the Red-Nose Pirates that has appeared in Mu Lung causing all sorts of problems. Tae Sang wants you to defeat the #rRed-Nose Pirates#k threatening the peace of Mu Lung and to eliminate their leader #r#o2600326##k.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta defeated the Red-Nose Pirates that were threating Mu Lung.

0.0: Mu Lung tries to say out of worldly affairs, but all these #rRed-Nose Pirates#k are dragging us down. They're plucking our herbs, attacking trainees... Nothing but hooligans, those pirates!
0.1: The trainees are skilled, but taught to be pacifists. You...don't look like a pacifist, so could you take care of them, please?

yes.0: Go to #b#MDmirrorD_324_4_##k and get those #rRed-Nose Pirates#k. And be sure to eliminate their leader, #r#o2600326##k. That's the only way we'll know peace in Mu Lung.

no.0: There is no way the trainees will be able to concentrate with all this chaos.

1.0: Have the Red-Nose Pirates been dealt with?

yes.0: I was concerned you might not be able to take them on by yourself, but you did a fantastic job. Mu Lung is at peace once again.
